notes.title: Patch Note - 2.0
notes.content:
August 25
Patch 2.0

Improvements:

1. New scenary: added Storm scenary. See the tutorial about it for more information.
2. New Rankings: around Storm scenary.
3. New ingame elements have been added: comic graphic elements, comic warning bubbles, comic narrative bubbles, hitkill counter. See the tutorial about them for more information.
4. The options screen have been remaked to support the configuration of new ingame elements.
5. The sound effects have been remaked.
6. The Conquests system have been remaked to include hitkill counter, and to simplify and comply with Steam rules.
7. Some physics and visual effects have been improved.
8. Some bugs have been fixed.
9. Now, the tutorial have a trainer room.

notes.title: Patch Note - 1.2
notes.content:
July 12 
Patch 1.2

Improvements:

1. The special attack and defense skill bars now show the countdown of the duration of their special skills.
2. The Tractor Beam skill now has a line indicative of the traction field.
3. The combokill and overkill effects now are correct. They were being displayed even when their respective UI components were hidden, and were displayed incorrectly.
4. The game pauses correctly to active screen switching operating system events, such as minimizing or switching applications.
5. The Cooldown Dropbox speed bonus now work correctly under water.

notes.title: Patch Note - 1.1
notes.content:
June 17 
Patch 1.1

Improvements:

1. The boss health bar did not represent the health of the boss with Healthy ability correctly.
2. The light and shadow effects of the molten and water scenaries were improved.
3. Now, the game also saves the Configs locally, so even offline the player will have access and control of the Configs.
